content.title: Phillips 66 CFO defends structure amid activist investor pressure
content.description:
Phillips 66 (PSX) has been under pressure from activist investor Elliott Management to split up its business and spin off parts in one of the biggest activist investor campaigns of 2025.

Phillips 66 CFO Kevin Mitchell sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to defend the company's current structure and to discuss how the company is navigating the activist investor demands.
